#function for running the between-person models
run_ma = function(data,analysis,rq,version,sample,parameter,domain,mods=NULL){
  
  
  if(analysis=='base'){
    model = rma(
      yi = yi,
      sei = sd,
      data = data,
      control=list(stepadj=0.25, maxiter=5000)
    )
  }
  else{
    mods = as.formula(mods)
    
    model = rma(
      yi = yi,
      sei = sd,
      data = data,
      mods = mods,
      control=list(stepadj=0.25, maxiter=5000)
    )
  }
  
  #save the model
  save(model, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/models/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,sample,domain, parameter))
  
  #save the tidied up model parameters + heterogeneity
  tau2 = model$tau2
  i2 = model$I2
  
  fx = broom::tidy(model,conf.int=T) %>%
    mutate(tau2=tau2,i2=i2)
  save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,sample,domain, parameter)) 
  
}


#function for running the within-person models
run_mv = function(data,analysis,rq,version,sample,parameter,mods=NULL){
  
  if(analysis == 'base'){
    
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,random = list(~ 1|domain,~ 1|SID/es.id)
      ,data = data
)
  }
  else{
    mods = as.formula(mods)
    
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,mods = mods
      ,random = list(~ 1|domain,~ 1|SID/es.id)
      ,data = data
)
  }
  
    #save the model
  save(model, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/models/%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,sample, parameter))
  
  #save the tidy version + heterogeneity estimates
  
  het = tibble(
    model$s.names,
    model$sigma2
  ) %>%
    t() %>%
    data.frame() %>%
    janitor::row_to_names(row_number=1) %>%
    rename_with(~paste0('sig2_',.x)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(),as.numeric))
  
  rownames(het) = NULL
  
  fx = broom::tidy(model,conf.int=T) %>%
    bind_cols(het)
  
save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,sample,parameter)) 

}


#function for running the within-person models -- alternative random effects structure (no domain)
run_mv.no_dmn = function(data,analysis,rq,version,sample,parameter,mods=NULL){

      ,data = data
)
  }
  else{
    mods = as.formula(mods)
    
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,mods = mods
      ,random = ~ 1|SID/es.id
      ,data = data
)
  }
  
    #save the model
  save(model, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/models/%s-%s-%s-alt.RData", rq,version,sample, parameter))

save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/%s/fx/%s-%s-%s-alt.RData", rq,version,sample,parameter))

### Import data

```{r include=FALSE}
attr0 = read_csv("../02-data/02-clean-data/all-univ-and-traits-merged-CLEAN.csv") %>%
  rename(yi=mean)
```

## 01. Between-person models (trait-by-trait)

### Set up the nested data frame

```{r}
bp.nest = attr0 %>%
  group_by(version,sample,parameter,domain) %>%
  nest()

bp.crossing = crossing(
  version = unique(bp.nest$version)
  ,sample = unique(bp.nest$sample)
  ,parameter = unique(bp.nest$parameter)
  ,domain = unique(bp.nest$domain)
  ,analysis = c('base','is_central','is_central-pos')
)

bp.models = bp.nest %>%
  merge(bp.crossing,by=c('version','sample','domain','parameter')) %>%
  mutate(rq = plyr::mapvalues(analysis,c('base','is_central','is_central-pos'),c('1A','2A','pos-2A'))) %>%
  mutate(mod_str = case_when(
    rq == '1A' ~ '',
    rq == '2A' ~ '~is_central',
    rq == 'pos-2A' ~ '~ ct_high + ct_low'
  )) %>%
  mutate(ran = '~1|SID/es.id') %>%
  mutate(data = map(data,~.x %>%
                    mutate(es.id = row_number()))) 
```

### Run the models

```{r}
bp.models %>%
   mutate(
     model = pmap(list(data,analysis,rq,version,sample,parameter,domain,mod_str),run_ma)) 
```

### Full meta-analysis

#### Between-person

##### Function for running the analyses

```{r}
run_mega.bp = function(d,analysis,rq,version,parameter,domain,mods=NULL){
  
  if(analysis == 'base'){
    
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,random = ~ 1|sample/es.id
      ,data = d
    )
    
  }else{
    mods = as.formula(mods)
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,mods = mods
      ,random = ~ 1|sample/es.id
      ,data = d
    )
    
  }
  
      #save the model
  save(model, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/bp-mega/models/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,domain, parameter))
  
  #save the tidy version + heterogeneity estimates
  sig_sample = model$sigma2[1]
  sig_res = model$sigma2[2]
  
  fx = broom::tidy(model,conf.int=T) %>%
    mutate(sig_sample=sig_sample,sig_res=sig_res)
  
  save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/bp-mega/fx/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,domain, parameter))
  
}


```

##### Prep data

```{r}
bp.mega = attr0 %>%
  group_by(version,parameter,domain) %>%
  nest()

bp.mega_crossing = crossing(
  version = unique(bp.mega$version)
  ,parameter = unique(bp.mega$parameter)
  ,domain = unique(bp.mega$domain)
  ,analysis = c('base','is_central','is_central-pos')
)

bp.mega_mods = bp.mega %>%
  merge(bp.mega_crossing,by=c('version','domain','parameter')) %>%
  mutate(rq = plyr::mapvalues(analysis,c('base','is_central','is_central-pos'),c('1A','2A','pos-2A'))) %>%
  mutate(mod_str = case_when(
    rq == '1A' ~ '',
    rq == '2A' ~ '~is_central',
    rq == 'pos-2A' ~ '~ ct_high + ct_low'
  )) %>%
  mutate(ran = '~1|sample/SID/es.id') %>%
  mutate(data = map(data,~.x %>%
                    mutate(es.id = row_number()))) 
```

```{r}
bp.mega_mods %>%
  mutate(send=pmap(list(data,analysis,rq,version,parameter,domain,mod_str),run_mega.bp))
```

#### Within-person

##### Function for running the analyses

```{r}
run_mega.wp = function(d,analysis,rq,version,parameter,mods=NULL){
  
  if(analysis == 'base'){
    
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,random = ~ 1|sample/SID/es.id
      ,data = d
    )
    
  }else{
    mods = as.formula(mods)
    model = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,mods = mods
      ,random = ~ 1|sample/SID/es.id
      ,data = d
    )
    
  }
  
      #save the model
  save(model, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/wp-mega/models/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version, parameter))
  
  #save the tidy version + heterogeneity estimates
  sig_sample = model$sigma2[1]
  sig_sid = model$sigma2[2]
  sig_res = model$sigma2[3]
  
  fx = broom::tidy(model,conf.int=T) %>%
    mutate(sig_sample=sig_sample,sig_sid=sig_sid,sig_res=sig_res)
  
  save(fx, file = sprintf("../04-results/metaregressions/wp-mega/fx/%s-%s-%s-%s.RData", rq,version,parameter))
  
}
```

##### Prep data

```{r}
wp.mega = attr0 %>%
  group_by(version,parameter) %>%
  nest()

wp.mega_crossing = crossing(
  version = unique(wp.mega$version)
  ,parameter = unique(wp.mega$parameter)
  ,analysis = c('base','is_central','is_central-pos')
)

wp.mega_mods = wp.mega %>%
  merge(wp.mega_crossing,by=c('version','parameter')) %>%
  mutate(rq = plyr::mapvalues(analysis,c('base','is_central','is_central-pos'),c('1B','2B','pos-2B'))) %>%
  mutate(mod_str = case_when(
    rq == '1B' ~ '',
    rq == '2B' ~ '~is_central',
    rq == 'pos-2B' ~ '~ ct_high + ct_low'
  )) %>%
  mutate(data = map(data,~.x %>%
                    mutate(es.id = row_number()))) 
```

##### Run the models

```{r}
test = wp.mega_mods$data[[1]]

mod_test = rma.mv(
      yi = yi
      ,V = vi
      ,random = ~ 1|sample/SID/es.id
      ,data = test
    )
```
